course_title: Fixed Income Analytics and Treasury Management
course_description:
Provides students with a comprehensive understanding of the corporate treasury management function. Covers bond mathematics and the concepts of duration and convexity. Valuation of embedded options, swaps, credit default swaps, collateralised debt obligations. Treasury risk management. The credit rating process.

course_aims: This course aims to provide an in-depth understanding of fixed income security markets and their analyses. These securities include treasury securities, municipal bonds, corporate bonds and international bonds, and structured debt securities. Their risk-return characteristics will be explained in terms of price-yield relationship, yield and return measures, and price volatility measures. Various techniques for the valuation, trading, and risk control of these securities will be illustrated in detail in association with yield curve analysis.

learning_outcomes.description: Understand the fundamentals of fixed income in the context of investment and trading.
Analyse the risk and returns of a wide variety of fixed income products.
Understand how fixed income products relate to other structured products.
Work collaboratively and efficiently in teams to complete tasks related to fixed income product.

assessment_details.title: Credit Rating Report
assessment_details.other_conditions: Peer assessment factor. See the conditions definitions
assessment_details.task_description: Each team is required to prepare a credit rating report on an ASX-listed company. Students will conduct a comprehensive credit risk analysis and assign a credit rating to the selected company. In preparing the report, students can draw on the credit rating methodologies used by major rating agencies. Team reports must be submitted by the deadline specified above. More detailed instructions will be provided on Blackboard. A peer review process will be used to provide feedback on individual contributions to the team assessment. Students must complete the peer review to receive their final mark for this assessment item. The results of the peer review may be used to adjust an individual student’s overall score for this assessment item, based on their peer-reviewed contribution and performance. Further information about the peer review process is provided in the Assessment Guideline on Blackboard. Read full task description Hide full task description
